title: fix(assistant): keep whitespace-only streamed chunks so spaces before numbers survive

files.patch:
@@ -77,10 +77,22 @@ def respond(previous_response_id: nil)
     def request_response(function_results: [], previous_response_id: nil, tool_choice: nil)
       response_has_text = false
 
+      leading_whitespace = +""
+
       streamer = proc do |chunk|
-        if chunk.type == "output_text" && chunk.data.present?
-          response_has_text = true
-          emit(:output_text, chunk.data)
+        # A whitespace-only chunk is real text (OpenAI streams the space before a number as its own chunk),
+        # but a message cannot be saved with whitespace-only content, so hold leading whitespace back
+        # until the first non-blank chunk arrives and emit it together with that chunk.
+        if chunk.type == "output_text" && !chunk.data.to_s.empty?
+          if response_has_text
+            emit(:output_text, chunk.data)
+          elsif chunk.data.blank?
+            leading_whitespace << chunk.data
+          else
+            response_has_text = true
+            emit(:output_text, leading_whitespace + chunk.data)
+            leading_whitespace = +""
+          end
         end
       end

@@ -41,6 +41,49 @@ def call(params = {}) = params
     assert_equal 8, Assistant::Responder::DEFAULT_MAX_TOOL_CALL_ITERATIONS
   end
 
+  test "streamed chunks that are only whitespace are emitted so the spaces before numbers survive" do
+    reply = Provider::LlmConcept::ChatResponse.new(
+      id: "1", model: "gpt-4.1",
+      messages: [ Provider::LlmConcept::ChatMessage.new(id: "1", output_text: "as of 10-22-2026") ],
+      function_requests: []
+    )
+
+    @llm.stubs(:chat_response).with do |_prompt, **kwargs|
+      [ "as", " of", " ", "10", "-", "22", "-", "202", "6" ].each do |text|
+        kwargs[:streamer].call(Provider::LlmConcept::ChatStreamChunk.new(type: "output_text", data: text, usage: nil))
+      end
+      true
+    end.returns(provider_success_response(reply))
+
+    streamed = []
+    @responder.on(:output_text) { |text| streamed << text }
+    @responder.respond
+
+    assert_equal "as of 10-22-2026", streamed.join
+  end
+
+  test "leading whitespace-only chunks are held back and emitted with the first non-blank chunk" do
+    reply = Provider::LlmConcept::ChatResponse.new(
+      id: "1", model: "gpt-4.1",
+      messages: [ Provider::LlmConcept::ChatMessage.new(id: "1", output_text: "\n Hello there") ],
+      function_requests: []
+    )
+
+    @llm.stubs(:chat_response).with do |_prompt, **kwargs|
+      [ "\n", " ", "Hello", " ", "there" ].each do |text|
+        kwargs[:streamer].call(Provider::LlmConcept::ChatStreamChunk.new(type: "output_text", data: text, usage: nil))
+      end
+      true
+    end.returns(provider_success_response(reply))
+
+    streamed = []
+    @responder.on(:output_text) { |text| streamed << text }
+    @responder.respond
+
+    assert_equal "\n Hello", streamed.first
+    assert_equal "\n Hello there", streamed.join
+  end
+
